name: Zaleplon
effects: GABA-A positive allosteric modulator (Z-drug) — shortest duration of all Z-drugs
Rapid onset sleep induction — can be taken after waking if 4+ hours remain
Minimal next-day sedation due to very short half-life
US Schedule IV; abuse potential lower than benzodiazepines

halfLifeEvidence.quote: a terminal-phase elimination half-life (t 1/2 ) of approximately 1 hour
